projectDescription: A free, open-source YouTube Music client for Android built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, featuring background playback, offline downloads, synced lyrics, music recognition, and real-time listen-together sessions.
keyFeatures: Stream songs and videos from YouTube Music without an account
Background playback with lock screen and notification controls
Download and cache songs for offline listening
Live synced lyrics with word-by-word highlighting from multiple providers (BetterLyrics, LrcLib, KuGou, YouTube)
Listen Together — real-time synchronized playback with friends
Full YouTube Music account sync (songs, albums, artists, playlists)
Equalizer, audio normalization, tempo & pitch control
Home screen widget and Quick Settings tile
Material 3 design with dynamic color, 19 palette options, light/dark/black/dynamic themes
Sleep timer with fade-out and automatic scheduling
Statistics page with listening history and play counts
publicApiSurface: PlayerConnection — exposes ExoPlayer state to UI via StateFlow
LyricsHelper — fetches and prioritizes lyrics from registered providers
LyricsProviderRegistry — register/query lyrics providers (BetterLyrics, KuGou, LrcLib, YouTube, SimpMusic, Paxsenix)
MusicRecognitionService — Shazam-based music recognition foreground service
DownloadUtil — manages ExoDownloader cache and offline song storage
SleepTimer — configurable sleep timer with auto-scheduling and fade-out
DatabaseDao — Room DAO for songs, albums, artists, playlists, podcasts, stats
InnerTube module — internal YouTube Music API client (Kotlin)
QuickSettings tile — QS tile for music recognition shortcut
